text: Highest bid never updated. Fix in BidService.

I fixed the bug in `src/auction-api/BidService.ts`. I haven't run the test itself, only typecheck and drift. Both are clean.

`placeBid` never recorded an accepted bid on the item. `highestBidAmount` and `highestBidderId` stayed null, so the second bid of 100 was still checked against the starting price and passed. After the bid is stored, `placeBid` now sets both fields on the item before calling `saveItem`. The next bid is then checked against the highest bid plus 1.

`Item.minimumBid()` already returned highest plus 1 when a bid exists, so I left it alone.
